resources.string: IR blaster ready — point phone at your TV
No IR blaster on this phone
Aim the top/back IR LED at the TV when pressing buttons
Need a phone with built-in IR (infrared) to control a TV
USB-C IR adapters are not supported
Select Haier (or Haier Alt if Power does not work). This app sends real IR signals through your phone\'s IR blaster — it cannot control a TV without IR hardware.

Your phone does not have a built-in infrared emitter, so it cannot send IR signals to a TV.

Use a phone that includes an IR blaster (common on many Xiaomi, Huawei, Redmi, Honor, and some Samsung models), then reinstall this APK.

Simulation mode has been removed — buttons only work with real IR hardware.
Swipe on the pad to move the TV cursor with real IR. Tap for OK. Works with a Bluetooth mouse too.
Open the on-screen keyboard on your TV first, then tap Reset cursor. Each key sends real IR arrow moves + OK to type on the TV.
